Srivatsan, currently Head – Compliance: Overseas Banking and Subsidiaries & Data Privacy Officer at ICICI Bank, has around 34 years of professional experience, including 25 years in BFSI.

sectors.title: Jeff Bezos' space firm Blue Origin says raising outside funds, a first
sectors.summary: Blue Origin CEO Dave Limp said Tuesday that the US-based space company will no longer be solely backed by Amazon founder Jeff Bezos and is fundraising with external investors. Though they were both founded in the early 2000s, Blue Origin has fallen behind SpaceX in the billionaire-backed space race, with rival Elon Musk's company achieving a historic stock listing in June by raising $85.7 billion for a valuation of $1.77 trillion.
